types.name: AttestationClosed
docs: v4 (L7): an attestation of a finished pool closed, its rent back to whoever paid it

fields.name: platform_fee_bps
docs: Share of the FEE share (not of the pool) that goes to `platform_treasury` at close.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Two-step authority handover: set by `propose_authority`, consumed by `accept_authority`.

fields.name: payout_authority
docs: Commits a pool's winners root, records ride attestations and closes a pool once its prizes are paid (the server's payout key) – nothing
else; a root it commits is public for the whole review lock and the cold admin can veto it. None = only `authority`.

fields.name: min_review_secs
docs: v4: the review window every new pool keeps after its play deadline, and the lock between a winners root's commit (or a ride attestation)
and the first payment on it (DEFAULT_MIN_REVIEW_SECS; set by the cold admin only).

fields.name: min_finish_secs
docs: v4: the play window every new pool keeps after its sale (no sale, no new ride after it – the shifts on the road finish) (DEFAULT_MIN_FINISH_SECS).

fields.name: max_tickets
docs: 0 = unlimited

fields.name: prep_deadline
docs: end of the sale window: no ticket is sold from here on; under the minimum the pool can only fail (refunds)

fields.name: play_deadline
docs: rides count until here

fields.name: payout_at
docs: end of the review window: prizes and the close only from here on

fields.name: authority
docs: Creator record (receives the vault rent minimum at close). Admin rights come from `Config.authority`.

fields.name: max_tickets
docs: 0 = unlimited

fields.name: payout_at
docs: end of the review window: no prize is paid and the pool is not closed before it

fields.name: seed_commitment
docs: v3: SHA256(pool_id LE u32 || blockhash || slot LE u64) of a recent block, fixed when the pool opens; the pool's road seed is
derived from it, so the operator could not have picked the road after seeing it. All zero for a `create_pool` pool given none.

fields.name: seed_slot
docs: the SlotHashes entry the commitment was made from (create_pool.rs seed_commitment_of)

fields.name: seal_slot
docs: v4 (L4): the slot whose hash seals the road (`seal_road`); 0 once sealed – until then `seed_commitment` is all zero and no ride is served

fields.name: platform_fee_bps
docs: v4 (L8): `Config.platform_fee_bps` when the pool opened – the cut at close is the one the buyers were shown

fields.name: winners_root
docs: v4 (H5-B): the committed winners – a Merkle root over (rank, wallet, lamports), the sum, the count, when, and the first moment it pays

fields.name: paid_mask
docs: bit r = rank r paid

fields.name: sponsor_refunded
docs: v4 (M8): sponsorship refunded to sponsors after a failure

fields.name: open_pledges
docs: v4 (L7): pledges on this pool not yet settled or refunded – attestations close only at 0

fields.name: min_review_secs
docs: v4: `Config.min_review_secs` when the pool opened – its review lock (a later change of the floor does not reach a running pool)

fields.name: prize_paid
docs: prizes paid out over the pool's life

fields.name: seed
docs: everything that went to seed_treasury (seed share + unclaimed prize [+ donations / sponsorship of a failed pool])

fields.name: fee
docs: fee share that went to fee_treasury (after the platform cut)

fields.name: rent_returned
docs: vault rent minimum returned to the authority

fields.name: from_series
docs: true = opened by `open_next_pool` from the tier's series, false = `create_pool` by the admin

types.name: RideAttestation
docs: v4 (audit H4): the server's verdict on ONE ride, written by the payout key – a pledge on that ride settles on it (`verified_km`), and only from
`settle_from` (the review lock: every RideAttestationRecorded is public that long first). Final once a pledge was settled on it.

types.name: RideAttestationRecorded
docs: v4 (H4): the server's verdict on one ride, for the pledges on it

types.name: RoadSealed
docs: v4 (L4): the pool's road seed, fixed from the hash of `seed_slot` – a slot after the pool opened, so nobody could pick it

types.name: SealRearmed
docs: the target slot had left the SlotHashes window before anyone sealed: a new target

types.name: Series
docs: One schedule per tier, written by the admin (`set_series`): every pool `open_next_pool` creates takes these rules. Pools tile time:
the next one opens when this one stops selling (`next_open_at`), so a 24 h sale window = one pool a day.

fields.name: max_tickets
docs: 0 = unlimited

fields.name: sale_secs
docs: sale window = cadence (seconds)

fields.name: play_secs
docs: after the sale ends, rides of the pool still count this long

fields.name: verify_secs
docs: after the play deadline: the review window before any prize is paid

fields.name: next_open_at
docs: the start of the next sale slot; `open_next_pool` is refused before it

fields.name: max_tickets
docs: 0 = unlimited

fields.name: sale_secs
docs: sale window AND cadence: the next pool opens when this one stops selling

fields.name: play_secs
docs: rides still count this long after the sale ends

fields.name: verify_secs
docs: review window after the play deadline, before any prize

fields.name: start_at
docs: the first sale slot starts here; 0 = keep the series' current `next_open_at` (refused for a new series)

types.name: SponsorReceipt
docs: v4 (audit M8): what `sponsor` put into a pool – `refund_sponsor` pays it back if the pool fails.

types.name: WinnersCommitted
docs: v4 (H5-B): the pool's winners, public for the whole review lock before any of them is paid
